source: An unpublished collection of 40 three-segment prompt scripts (segments A/B/C; in a 'revisit' script segment C returns to the subject and scene of segment A). The collection is not distributed with this repository: the six records used are reproduced in full in the output file, and source_sha256 identifies the version of the collection they were taken from.
selection: First six revisit records, preserving their A/B/C text verbatim. C revisits A with a later action; it is not necessarily identical wording.
